thread:
maya: Heads up 1: we're finalizing the benchmark narrative for the launch page + webinar. Need two contrasting chart hooks and three short hero lines. Can design start mocking if we lock the concepts now?

jon: I can give provisional numbers but won't approve public claims until infra signs off. Use placeholders like <P95_MS> and <COST_PER_1K>. I'll post a verified CSV by EOD.

sergio: Proposed chart hooks:
  1) "Cost curve" 1: X-axis = request size (tokens), Y-axis = cost per 1k tokens, separate lines for baseline vs Redwood routing. Clear procurement hook.
  2) "Routing waterfall" 1: stacked area showing percent of requests served by low-cost variants over time with p95 latency band overlay. Story-focused for product execs.
  3) Bonus: small inset "latency distribution" violin plots per slice for ops teams.

elaine: Copy needs to be short and concrete. My hero drafts:
  - "Same outputs. Lower spend."
  - "Keep latency steady. Cut unit economics."
  - "Predictable latency at lower cost."

sam: For social, very short/testable snippets: "Lower inference spend. Keep latency." and "See a cost chart for your app." Avoid numeric multipliers until jon confirms.

maya: Good. We also need two CTAs: "Get a custom cost chart" and "Book a 10-min demo." Lower friction = chart.

jon: CSV columns I'll export: model, quant, variant, workload_slice, p50_ms, p95_ms, tokens_per_req, throughput_tps, cost_per_1k. Also include notes column for "caching on/off".

sergio: Design notes: use Redwood green for the gain line/area, muted charcoal for baseline. Callouts: "short chats", "long instructions", "embeddings". Small footnote: "Workload-dependent; hardware: <HARDWARE>".

maya: SDR asks: a 1-liner opener and a quick rebuttal for "we already tuned infra."

elaine: Draft SDR one-liner: "We can show a 1-slide cost chart for your app in 10 minutes 1 no commitments." Rebuttal: "Totally 1 we complement infra; routing + caching often finds low-cost wins without changing your model stack."

devbot: deploy-bot: New design branch created: feature/bench-viz-1768005555 by sergio.

jon: Note: define "per-token" in methodology. Do we include prompt prefix amortization? Suggest we add a brief methodology blurb in the deck: what was measured, batching, caching, hardware, dataset.

sergio: Will annotate charts with p95 hotspots and a tiny methodology tooltip. Also can produce a single-panel PNG for social and a multi-pane SVG for the site.

maya: Timeline: concept lock today -> design mocks by tomorrow morning -> content + deck by Friday. Jon, circle back with verified CSV so we can swap in numbers.

sam: Quick A/B plan: hero line A = "Same outputs. Lower spend." hero line B = "Keep latency steady. Cut cost." CTAs: chart vs demo. Run landing A/B for two weeks, measure CTA conversions.

jon: I'll aim to post verified numbers by 18:00 PST. Please keep copy generic until then.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone 1 will drop the design link here when ready. :thumbsup:
